items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Bix Beiderbecke and Frankie (Trumbauer Pee Wee (Trombone?), Peter Russell and those guys came up from Hudson Lake, Indiana on their night off... And we'd finish at twelve o'clock and then we'd all go to hear Louis Armstrong

ctx.x: It was something. Everybody was talking about us. Louis Armstrong used to come over and sit behind the bandstand before he went to work at Sunset Café. Two or three nights a week. You know, sometimes a couple of times a week he'd come over and just sit and listen to us play. We were really (out of) it you know. Louis would come over and hear us, but the band was swinging and it was a good band.

Bix Beiderbecke and Frankie (Trumbauer Pee Wee (Trombone?), Peter Russell and those guys came up from Hudson Lake, Indiana on their night off, Monday nights. And they'd come up and listen to us that night. And we'd finish at twelve o'clock and then we'd all go to hear Louis Armstrong at the Sunset Café.
